description_en: Retrieves the download link for the offline Logview file of an instance in a specified MaxCompute project. The link is valid for 10 minutes from the time it is generated
description_zh: 获取指定 MaxCompute 项目中实例的离线 Logview 文件下载链接，链接自生成起有效期为 10 分钟
name: GetLogviewDownloadUrl

parameters.help_en: The name of the MaxCompute project. This parameter is used to specify the project to which the instance whose offline Logview is to be downloaded belongs
parameters.help_zh: MaxCompute 项目名称，用于指定待下载离线 Logview 的实例所属项目
parameters.name: project

parameters.help_en: The ID of the MaxCompute instance. The instance must belong to the project specified by the project parameter
parameters.help_zh: MaxCompute 实例 ID。该实例须属于 project 参数指定的项目
parameters.name: instance

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the OSS VPC endpoint to generate the download link. Valid values:
false: Uses the default OSS endpoint.
true: Uses the OSS VPC endpoint configured on the server. The download client must have network access to this endpoint.
Default value: false. If this parameter is set to true and no OSS VPC endpoint is configured on the server, link generation fails and does not automatically fall back
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用 OSS VPC 访问地址生成下载链接。
false：使用默认 OSS 访问地址。
true：使用服务端配置的 OSS VPC 访问地址，下载客户端需具备访问该地址的网络条件。
默认值为 false。设为 true 且服务端未配置 OSS VPC 访问地址时，生成链接失败，不会自动回退
parameters.name: use_vpc_endpoint

schema.description_en: The response structure. Upon success, the data field contains the download link and the requestId field contains the request ID. The common fields httpCode, errorCode, and errorMsg are not assigned values when this operation is successfully processed. Their serialized representation is subject to the actual response
schema.description_zh: 返回结果。成功时 data 为下载链接，requestId 为请求 ID。通用字段 httpCode、errorCode、errorMsg 在本接口成功处理时不赋值，其序列化呈现以实际响应为准

data.description_en: The presigned OSS download URL for the offline Logview file. The URL is valid for 10 minutes from the time it is generated. The file name extension is .txt and the content is JSON data in UTF-8 encoding. The download URL is determined by useVpcEndpoint. If the link expires, invoke this operation again. The sample URL is desensitized and cannot be used for actual downloads
data.description_zh: 离线 Logview 文件的 OSS 预签名下载 URL，自生成起有效期为 10 分钟。文件扩展名为 .txt，内容为 UTF-8 编码的 JSON 数据。下载地址由 useVpcEndpoint 决定；链接过期后请重新调用本接口。示例 URL 已脱敏，不能用于实际下载

errorCode.description_en: The error code. This field is not assigned a value when this operation is successfully processed. The sample value NO_PERMISSION is used to illustrate a common permission error and must not be combined with the success response example
errorCode.description_zh: 错误码。本接口成功处理时不赋值。示例 NO_PERMISSION 用于说明通用权限错误，不能与成功响应示例合并

errorMsg.description_en: The error message. This field is not assigned a value when this operation is successfully processed. The sample value Forbidden is used to illustrate a common permission error and must not be combined with the success response example
errorMsg.description_zh: 错误信息。本接口成功处理时不赋值。示例 Forbidden 用于说明通用权限错误，不能与成功响应示例合并

httpCode.description_en: The HTTP status code field. This field is not assigned a value when this operation is successfully processed. Do not rely solely on whether this field equals 200 to determine success. Process the result based on the actual HTTP response status and returned content. The sample value 200 is used only to illustrate the field format
httpCode.description_zh: HTTP 状态码字段。本接口成功处理时不赋值，不应仅依赖该字段是否等于 200 判断是否成功。请结合实际 HTTP 响应状态与返回内容处理结果。示例 200 仅说明字段格式

requestId.description_en: The request ID. This ID is used to locate and troubleshoot the request
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查本次请求
